mode: Research and editorial staging only. No publication, code changes, repository writes, KB writes, or nested agents.

policy.rule: One included state nursing listing is the sole potential review recipient where its CMS duplicate is included_cms_only. Never score both or silently merge saved IDs. Primary identity corroboration does not itself resolve care-unit or review-population ambiguity.

access.finding: Public property paths allowed; terms prohibit disruptive-volume scraping. Four serial direct property reads, plus one rendered revisit to verify Elizabeth controls. No MyLivingChoice API, login, restricted page, report action, inquiry, or submission used.
access.operatorFinding: Public contact/home pages and robots checked. No applicable automation prohibition identified on the inspected pages or targeted terms searches. Absence of a found terms page is not a blanket license or permission to republish narratives.

policy.privacy: No reviewer, resident, relative, employee, administrator, or individual owner names; no quotes, contact details of individuals, avatars, or medical narratives retained. Public facility contacts and corporate licensed operators only. Original review identifiers and URLs retained for audit.
policy.dateBasis: Calendar-month labels in the public MyLivingChoice response. Original Google posting days are unknown; do not manufacture first-of-month posting dates. Google relative-age labels are not converted to exact calendar months.
policy.populationLimit: All five accounts on each direct MyLivingChoice page were read before selection. These are platform-selected windows, not all reported ratings, verified residents, independent people, or representative prevalence. Google place panels were checked for identity and aggregate comparison, not collected as a full second review window. A targeted expanded professional account at Elizabeth is separately flagged and never added to the five-row denominator.
policy.clinicalSeparation: No CMS quality rating, inspection result, staffing fact, admission eligibility claim, or operator promotional star claim contributes to the consumer aggregate.
